question.stem: A 58-year-old man develops progressive difficulty swallowing and has lost 8 kg unintentionally. What is the most appropriate next step?

options.B: Reassure and review in one year
options.C: Trial of a proton pump inhibitor

question.why_correct: Progressive dysphagia with weight loss is an alarm presentation requiring urgent investigation for serious oesophageal or upper gastrointestinal disease.
question.why_wrong: B. Delaying investigation risks missing significant disease. C. An empirical PPI trial delays urgent investigation of alarm symptoms. D. Physiotherapy is unrelated. E. Allergic rhinitis does not explain progressive dysphagia and weight loss.
